cases.prompt: How do I find my order history?
cases.text:
To view your past orders:

1. Open the app and tap the Profile tab (usually the person icon).  
2. In the My Account section, select Order History.  

Alternatively, open the side drawer (menu) and choose My Orders.  

Both paths will show a list of your recent orders. If you need help with a specific order, let me know which one.
cases.note: Uses existing Profile/My Account/Order History and drawer My Orders destinations
